title: Ninety seconds
objective: say who you are and why you are calling, in ninety seconds

title: What I do and what I am answerable for
objective: separate what you do from what you are answerable for

title: Four questions and a fifth
objective: ask a new counterpart four questions, and the fifth that nobody asks

title: Roles, not people
objective: explain a colleague's role without tying it to a person

title: That is not mine — and here is what I will do
objective: say what is not yours without passing anybody the buck

title: Keeping it going
objective: keep a first call going, usefully, past forty seconds

title: Review & Mediate: who is on this account?
objective: Review & Mediate: who is on this account, and who is not
